notes.title: Nov. 27th Update Announcement
notes.content:
Hello folks. the new update is online, in current build we have fixed the level up issue. Next we will be trying to adjust the values, we will keep you guys update, please have faith in us. Thanks again for supporting FTA games and TapTap Princess.

If you encounter a problem at this stage, please try to quickly click the logo in the upper left corner ten times in succession to turn on the debug mode.

notes.title: Nov. 13th Update Announcement
notes.content: Hello folks, thanks for your support, in this update we have fixed the skill tree reset issue. Next we will be fixing the unable to level up issue, we will keep you guys update, please have faith in us. Thanks again for supporting FTA games and TapTap Princess.

notes.title: Sep. 19th Update Announcement
notes.content: Hello folks, thanks for your support, in this update we have fixed the number of diamonds you can get from the treasure bought in the team page. Next we will be fixing the unable to level up issue and skill tree issue, we will keep you guys update, please have faith in us. Thanks again for supporting FTA games and TapTap Princess.
